tables.title: Effect of low-power modes on the LPTIM
tables.text: Table 569, "Effect of low-power modes on the LPTIM", in section 58.5 (LPTIM low-power modes) on page 2951. Columns: Mode, Description. 3 data row(s).

rows: No effect. LPTIM interrupts cause the device to exit Sleep mode.

If the LPTIM is clocked by an oscillator available in Stop mode, LPTIM is 
functional and the interrupts cause the device to exit the Stop mode.

The LPTIM peripheral is powered down and must be reinitialized after 
exiting Standby mode.
